SELECT MIN(t.title) AS movie_title
FROM (
    SELECT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    WHERE mc.company_id IN (
        SELECT cn.id
        FROM company_name AS cn
        WHERE cn.country_code = '[de]'
    )
    AND mc.movie_id IN (
        SELECT mk.movie_id
        FROM movie_keyword AS mk
        WHERE mk.keyword_id IN (
            SELECT k.id
            FROM keyword AS k
            WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
        )
    )
) AS filtered_movie_ids
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = filtered_movie_ids.movie_id
